summary: MonkerSolver entry 16 and shortlist slot 7 rest the exclusion on 'no scripting interface'; the vendor page indeed documents none, but a third-party guide dated 31 March 2026 (plodalong.com/articles/monkersolver-scripting) documents a built-in Scripting tool under the Solve menu that batch-solves a board list against a saved tree. Batch study, not a live API, but it contradicts 'no scripting interface' and may move the (d) rating. Out of scope for round-3 findings F1-F6; F5 only directed resting the claim on the vendor page.
